goal: Prompt for Accessibility and Input Monitoring on first native need and let permission-health retest re-request those OS prompts (SET-003, SET-004, CAP-003, CAP-010, ADR-005).
outcome: Production path calls AXIsProcessTrustedWithOptions with prompt and CGRequestListenEventAccess off the event-tap callback; fakes prove the request hook fires without real TCC dialogs; Screen Recording is never requested and stays Not used; denial still leaves the manual composer.

requirements.statement: Never accept ADR-002, ADR-009, or ADR-018 silently; leave them Proposed.
Do not copy Cooper source or Copper trade dress.
Event-tap callbacks must not touch AX, DB, windows, clipboard, or logging. Permission requests run off the tap callback thread.
No network, telemetry, accounts, remote fonts, CDN, hosted AI, or analytics.
Every user-facing string belongs in the locale catalog. No sentence concatenation.
Preserve requirement IDs in implementation notes, tests, and evidence.
Never call Screen Recording request or preflight APIs. Keep Screen Recording Not used.
Work only on branch bmad/bronze-autonomous; never push.
Do not invent a Swift verify command; pnpm verify is the repo bar.
Do not revert sibling README Corepack removal or fight package.json / packageManager / rust-toolchain. No corepack commands in docs.

On native runtime start and first capture path, request Accessibility (AXIsProcessTrustedWithOptions prompt) and Input Monitoring (CGRequestListenEventAccess) when not already granted. Never loop-prompt on launch.
Permission-health retest re-triggers the OS prompt when the OS allows it; if the OS will not re-prompt, System Settings deep-link is fallback after a prompt attempt, not instead of it.
Tests inject a fake request hook so CI never shows real permission dialogs. Production source requests prompt; it is not preflight-only. Denial leaves the manual composer.
